description.value: Gathering Place is a City of Vancouver–operated community centre located in the downtown core on Helmcken Street. It serves as a publicly accessible gathering and recreation hub in one of Vancouver's densest urban neighbourhoods. A touring cyclist passing through downtown Vancouver could use it as a rest and services stop.
